candidate.answerReason: All interior multiples of 4 cancel between numerators and denominators, leaving 2008/4 = 502.

methods.label: Cancel the repeated factors
methods.explanation:
Each numerator except the last is the denominator of the next fraction. Combining the fractions makes these cancellations visible:
\[
\frac{8\cdot12\cdot16\cdots2004\cdot2008}
{4\cdot8\cdot12\cdots2000\cdot2004}.
\]
Every multiple of \(4\) from \(8\) through \(2004\) occurs once above and once below. All these factors are positive, so they may be canceled. Only the first denominator and last numerator remain, giving
\[
\frac{2008}{4}=502.
\]
The answer is \(502\), choice B.
methods.levelReason: Recognizing repeated factors and canceling them requires only elementary fraction multiplication.

candidate.annotationRationale: The decisive target is recognizing cancellation across a finite product and retaining the correct endpoints. Fraction multiplication and reduction support the calculation; no sequence formula is used.
